items.title: GAP swaps party founder for social worker ahead of polls
items.summary: The Gambia Action Party (GAP) has entrusted its State House bid to Ba Samba Drammeh, handing the social worker and human rights advocate the party’s ticket for the December 5 presidential election, while party founder Musa Ousainou Yali Batchilly assumes the role of running ma...
